In [[geometry]] of the Euclidean plane, the '''3-4-6-12 tiling''' is one of 20 [[2-uniform tiling]]s of the [[Euclidean plane]] [[Tiling by regular polygons|by regular polygons]], containing regular [[triangle]]s, [[square]]s, [[hexagon]]s and [[dodecagon]]s, arranged in two [[vertex configuration]]: 3.4.6.4 and 4.6.12.<ref>Critchlow, pp. 62–67</ref><ref>Grünbaum and Shephard 1986, pp. 65–67</ref><ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20150710230158/http://www.math.nus.edu.sg/aslaksen/papers/Demiregular.pdf In Search of Demiregular Tilings] #4</ref><ref>Chavey (1989)</ref>

It has [[hexagonal tiling|hexagonal]] [[List of planar symmetry groups#Wallpaper groups|symmetry]], p6m, [6,3], (*632). It is also called a [[demiregular tiling]] by some authors.

== Geometry==
Its two [[vertex configuration]]s are shared with two 1-uniform tilings:
{| class=wikitable
![[rhombitrihexagonal tiling]]
![[truncated trihexagonal tiling]]
|- align=center
|[[File:1-uniform_n6.svg|160px]]<BR>3.4.6.4
|[[File:1-uniform_n3.svg|160px]]<BR>4.6.12
|}

It can be seen as a type of [[Diminishment (geometry)|diminished]] [[rhombitrihexagonal tiling]], with dodecagons replacing periodic sets of hexagons and surrounding squares and triangles. This is similar to the [[Johnson solid]], a [[diminished rhombicosidodecahedron]], which is a [[rhombicosidodecahedron]] with faces removed, leading to new decagonal faces. The dual of this variant is shown to the right (deltoidal hexagonal insets).
: [[File:1-uniform_6_with_dodecagons.png|160px]][[File:Dual of Planar Tiling (Uniform Two 5) 4.6.12; 3.4.6.4 Corrected Variant O.png|frameless|160x160px]]

== Related ''k''-uniform tilings of regular polygons==

== Circle Packing ==
This 2-uniform tiling can be used as a [[circle packing]]. Cyan circles are in contact with 3 other circles (2 cyan, 1 pink), corresponding to the V4.6.12 planigon, and pink circles are in contact with 4 other circles (1 cyan, 2 pink), corresponding to the V3.4.6.4 planigon. It is [[Homeomorphism|homeomorphic]] to the ambo operation on the tiling, with the cyan and pink gap polygons corresponding to the cyan and pink circles (mini-vertex configuration polygons; one dimensional duals to the respective planigons). Both images coincide.

=== Dual tiling ===
The dual tiling has [[right triangle]] and [[Kite (geometry)|kite]] faces, defined by [[face configuration]]s: V3.4.6.4 and V4.6.12, and can be seen combining the [[deltoidal trihexagonal tiling]] and [[kisrhombille tiling]]s.
